name: Citation Counts
author: Synapse
description: How often each paper in your library is cited, from OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar: a Citations column, a search filter (citations:>100) and a row in the item pane. Counts are fetched for new papers at once and refreshed every week.

settings.label: Also ask Semantic Scholar
settings.description: First for arXiv preprints (it counts a preprint and its journal version together), and for papers OpenAlex does not know.
